Platform-2 → {{stl|Chennai Metro|Poonamallee Bypass}} | tracks = 2 | structure = Underground, [[Double-track railway|Double track]] | levels = 2 | accessible = Yes {{access icon}} | status = Under Construction | opening = {{start date and age|df=yes|December 2027}} '''''(TBC)''''' | electrified = Single phase 25 kV, 35 Hz AC through [[overhead catenary]] | services = {{adjacent stations|system=Chennai Metro|line1=Yellow|left1=Boat Club|to-left1=Poonamallee Bypass|right1=Alwarpet|to-right1=Lighthouse|line2=Yellow|left2=Boat Club|to-left2=Parandur Airport|note-mid2=''(Future Service)''|right2=Alwarpet|to-right2=Lighthouse}} | map_type = | map_size = | map_dot_label = | route_map = {{Chennai Metro Yellow Line Route}} | map_state = collapsed | mapframe = yes | mapframe-marker = rail | mapframe-marker-color = #{{rail color|Chennai Metro|Yellow}} | mapframe-zoom = 14 }} '''Bharathidasan Road''' is an upcoming underground metro station on the East-West Corridor of the [[Yellow Line (Chennai Metro)|Yellow Line]] of [[Chennai Metro]] in [[Chennai]], India. This metro station will be among the 30 stations of Corridor IV and 12 underground stations along Corridor IV of the Chennai Metro, [[Poonamallee Bypass metro station|Poonamallee Bypass]]–[[Lighthouse metro station|Lighthouse]] stretch. This metro station is slated to be commercialized on December 2027.{{Cite web |title=Chennai Metro Phase 2 – Information, Route Maps, Tenders & Updates |url=https://themetrorailguy.com/chennai-metro-phase-2-information-map/ |access-date=2025-04-07 |website=The Metro Rail Guy |language=en-US}} ==History== In February 2021, Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) initiated the bidding process for the construction of this Bharathidasan Road metro station, which falls within the underground stretch from [[Lighthouse metro station|Light House]] to [[Bharathidasan Road metro station|Bharathidasan Road]], forming part of [[Line 4 (Chennai Metro)|Corridor 4]] under Phase 2 of the [[Chennai Metro]] project. {{Cite web |date=2021-08-16 |title=6 Bidders for Chennai Metro Line-4's Underground Work |url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2021/08/16/6-bidders-for-chennai-metro-line-4s-underground-work/ |access-date=2025-04-08 |website=The Metro Rail Guy |language=en-US}} Apart from this metro station, this package includes three other stations, namely [[Lighthouse metro station|Light House]], [[Kutchery Road metro station|Kutchery Road]] and [[Alwarpet metro station|Alwarpet]]. The tender attracted competitive bids from major infrastructure firms including ITD Cementation India Ltd., [[Larsen & Toubro|Larsen & Toubro (L&T)]], [[Gülermak|Gulermak]], Shanghai Tunnel Engineering Co. Ltd. (STEC), and a [[joint venture]] of J Kumar Infraprojects–Patel Infrastructure. After careful technical and financial assessment, '''ITD Cementation India Ltd.''' emerged as the lowest bidder and was awarded the contract.{{Cite web |date=2021-11-25 |title=ITD Cem Wins Chennai Metro Line-4's Underground Work |url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2021/11/25/itd-cem-wins-chennai-metro-line-4s-underground-work/ |access-date=2025-04-08 |website=The Metro Rail Guy |language=en-US}} The company commenced civil construction activities, including site clearance and preparatory excavation, aligned with the project’s underground engineering specifications. {{Cite web |date=2022-01-13 |title=ITD Cem Awarded Chennai Metro Line-4's Underground Contracts |url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2022/01/13/itd-cem-awarded-chennai-metro-line-4s-underground-contracts/ |access-date=2025-04-08 |website=The Metro Rail Guy |language=en-US}} == Station layout == '''''Station Layout - To Be Confirmed''''' {{stack|{{Routemap | title = Bharathidasan Road track layout ''(TBC)'' | title-bg = #{{rail color|Chennai Metro|Yellow}} | title-color = blue | legend = track | collapsible = no | map = HSTg\HSTf PSTR(L)\PSTR(R) ~~ ~~ ~~ to {{stl|Chennai Metro|Alwarpet}} ** *'''P1'''\PSTR(L)\PSTR(R)\*'''P2''' PSTR(L)\PSTR(R) ~~ ~~ ~~ to {{stl|Chennai Metro|Boat Club}} ** HSTg\HSTf | bottom =

extract: Bharathidasan Road is an upcoming underground metro station on the East-West Corridor of the Yellow Line of Chennai Metro in Chennai, India. This metro station will be among the 30 stations of Corridor IV and 12 underground stations along Corridor IV of the Chennai Metro, Poonamallee Bypass–Lighthouse stretch.
